svg.title: Allow content-specific imagery inside stable session-card rules
svg.desc: Only three selected-photo href attributes change from one generic studio image to clay, seed-packing and coffee images. These existing generated photographs deliberately differ in subject and photographic content. Every card retains its own copy, Source Serif4 title/Source Sans3 facts, font sizes/weights/anchors, fixed220×146.667 full-image fitting, arrangement, paired-square signature, colors and surface. No claim that image selection isolates semantic effects or that object crops/content remain identical. Fictional flat-artwork programme cards. Existing AI-generated photographic artwork; native type and layout composed separately.
